summary: The implementation successfully addresses all requested requirements. Per-item camera attachment buttons have been added to all 7 checklist items with neumorphic styling and touch-friendly sizing. An inline camera interface (CameraCapture component) is displayed within the main screen flow when a user clicks an attach button. Photos are correctly associated with their corresponding checklist items via a Map<string, File> state structure. The backend has been updated to accept per-item photos through a new ChecklistItem structure that includes an optional photo field, and a migration module handles the schema change. PDF generation now includes per-item photos displayed next to their corresponding items. Form reset functionality clears all captured photos, resets attach buttons, and closes the camera interface. All constraints are maintained: the camera is inline (not modal), the neumorphic design system is preserved, touch targets meet the 44px minimum, and the 7 predefined checklist items remain unchanged.

hallucinated_features.description: Switch camera button functionality in CameraCapture component
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly lists 'Multiple photos per checklist item' as a non-goal and does not request camera switching capability. The CameraCapture component includes a switch camera button with conditional rendering based on screen width.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module for backend schema changes
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement specified the need for a migration system to handle existing data when updating the backend schema. The migration.mo file transforms old submission format to new format with per-item photos.
